Why do they seem so...sad?|audio = FrostWave21-1.ogg|[[Professor V]] on Wave 14 ([[Frost Mode|Frost]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Crying Angel''' is a [[Flying]] enemy that appears in the [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. Like most of that mode's enemies, it first appeared in the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. It has low health though it moves quite fast. As it is a [[Flying]] enemy, only towers and units with flying detection can target it. ==Logbook Description== "''The Crying Angel is a follower of the Frost Spirit. It is created when devoted members of the Frost Army undergoes handpicked transformation. Through the Frost Spirit's will, any creature can become one of these aerial beings adorned with chains, wings, and the Follower’s Halo. These transformed creatures now circle above the Frost Spirit's cathedral-like castle, tirelessly waiting for their next orders.''" ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Current |The '''Crying Angel''' is an entity with a light blue skin, white torso and white legs. It has two light blue wings connected to its torso with grey chains, which are wrapped around its torso. It also had a light blue spiked halo floating above its head, which is the Follower's Halo. |Version 1 |The '''Crying Angel''' was entirely made out of translucent blue ice. Its torso and legs were darker than its head and arms. It had two light blue wings connected to its torso with blue chains, which were wrapped around its torso. It also had a light blue spiked halo floating above its head. }} ==Strategy== *Towers with flying detection, like the [[Golden Soldier]], [[Crook Boss]], [[Ranger]], [[Operator]] and [[Mercenary Base]]'s [[Rifleman]] are recommended against this. **Due to it generally spawning in groups, AOE towers with flying detection like the [[Mortar]] and [[Tesla]] can be used to take out multiple at once. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} KRCryingAngel.png|First Version (16 December 2024) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1CryingAngel.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseCryingAngel.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} CryingAngelIconIG.png|'''Crying Angel''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Crying Angel''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''16 December 2024''' -
